title: Content Reviewer United States - English-speaking
description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

description:
Homeless Services, Coordinated Entry System Coordinator

ICF ’s Homeless Services team works with federal agencies, state and local governments, non-profits, and other community partners to implement evidence-based best practices and to innovate and identify new solutions to end homelessness. ICF is currently seeking an experienced and mission-oriented candidate to support the implementation and operation of a Coordinated Entry System (CES) for a large Continuum of Care (CoC). 
As a critical member of the CES implementation team, the CES Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating program operations related to the CES process and workflow. This includes effectively matching housing referrals to program openings and unit vacancies; actively monitoring CES workflows to ensure resource alignment; supporting system navigation activities to reduce move-in timelines; and addressing barriers at both the system- and program-levels to ensure continuous CES outflow. The position serves as a key liaison between housing providers, outreach teams, shelters, access sites, and other community partners to facilitate effective housing matching, referral management, and successful housing placements.

Please note: This role is contingent upon a contract award. While it is not an immediate opening, we are actively conducting interviews and extending offers in anticipation of the award.

Key Responsibilities:  

Coordinated Entry Implementation

• Implement CoC CES policies, procedures, and requirements, including administration of CES assessment tools, prioritization policies, referral processes and workflows (including relevant HMIS technologies), project-level eligibility, and matching protocols.

• Conduct CoC-defined coordinated entry administration and management procedures and protocols to reduce unit vacancies, expedite the rate of referrals from CES to housing, and improve move-in processes for households experiencing homelessness.

• Gather and analyze data on household strengths and barriers and program-level service offerings and eligibility criteria to remove barriers to housing and to improve CES processes.

• Implement all CES guidance in a standardized and uniform manner, including housing applications, service coordination activities, and data tracking to ensure transparency and fairness in CES operations.

• Support cross-functional, interagency, and system-wide collaboration to identify process and workflow issues, and coordinate with appropriate leadership to develop and implement solutions across the CES.

Training and Technical Assistance

• Contribute to the development of training materials to CES access sites and CES participating providers, including compliance training, operational forms/guides, and technical assistance materials such as FAQ documents and toolkits.

• Translate policy requirements and technical documentation into action-oriented CES processes to improve CES throughput.

• Model appropriate CES protocols and procedures with service providers and participating CES partners through coaching, expert facilitation, and adherence to defined policies and procedures to ensure fidelity to CES design standards and program implementation.

• Identify process improvements to increase the timeliness of referrals to housing options for which households experiencing homelessness are eligible and prioritized.

• All other duties assigned, which may include field-based support, staffing augmentation, direct training, technical assistance, and capacity building, and quality assurance monitoring.

Communication and Collaboration

• Develop excellent working relationships with local partners within defined CoC or sub-CoC geographies, including CES participating providers, CES access sites, affordable housing providers, and partners from other systems of care such as behavioral health and substance use treatment facilities.

We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. title: Principal Infrastructure Architect: Data Platform
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen-fast.

As a Principal Infrastructure Architect on our Infrastructure Architecture team, you will be the architecture team's partner to ZoomInfo 's data engineering organization. Data engineering owns the platforms and the products built on them. You bring the infrastructure patterns, evaluation rigor, and cross-team alignment that help them build and run those platforms well on GCP.
This is a cloud architect seat with a data specialty. You bring the same cloud, Kubernetes, networking, and infrastructure-as-code foundation as the rest of the architecture team, plus enough hands-on depth in data systems to be credible with the engineers who run them.
The work breaks down four ways:

•
Patterns. You establish and maintain the paved-road patterns data teams build on: infrastructure as code, CI/CD for data jobs and pipelines, monitoring and alerting, performance, and cost. You keep them easy to consume and self-service.

•
Enablement and alignment. You help data teams adopt those patterns, review their designs, and work through hard infrastructure trade-offs with them.

•
Evaluation. You run POCs of new data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process, and you write recommendations engineering leaders can act on.

•
Shared stewardship. You take a full share of the architecture team's general work: weekly architecture reviews across all domains, standards and ADRs, and infrastructure consulting for any team that needs it.

The data estate is broad. We don't expect deep experience across all of it. We expect real depth in some areas and the ability to build depth in others as the work demands. Patterns get adopted here through leadership and communication rather than positional authority. You'll write reference implementations, open the first PRs, and stay hands-on through enablement when a critical initiative calls for it.
What You'll Do

•
Establish infrastructure patterns for data workloads. Design and maintain reference patterns for provisioning and operating the data platforms ZoomInfo runs: streaming and messaging (Kafka/Confluent, Pub/Sub), operational databases (PostgreSQL/Cloud SQL, MongoDB), analytical stores (BigQuery, Snowflake), search (Elasticsearch/Solr), pipeline orchestration and processing (Apache Airflow/Cloud Composer, Dataflow/Apache Beam), and open table formats (Apache Iceberg). Ship them as Terraform modules, GitOps workflows, and documented standards that data teams can adopt without reinventing them.

•
Build the data paved road. Today's delivery tooling is application-centric. Define CI/CD and GitOps patterns for data jobs and pipelines, and partner with platform engineering and data engineering to make data delivery as safe and automated as application delivery.

•
Establish performance, cost, and observability patterns. Give data teams the patterns and guidance to run stores and pipelines efficiently (query and storage optimization, partitioning and clustering, tiering and retention, workload isolation, right-sizing) and the monitoring, alerting, and SLO practices that make performance and cost visible. Set the baseline patterns for backup, restore, and disaster recovery of data stores, including RTO/RPO targets. Partner with FinOps on data-layer spend. Review workloads with teams against these patterns and help them align.

•
Evaluate new technologies. Run structured POCs of emerging data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process. Recent examples include graph and distributed SQL databases, stream processing (Apache Flink, Confluent Flink), and schema management and catalo

title: Product Manager (US Cards)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

- Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

- Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

- Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

- Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

- Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

- 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

- You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

- You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

- You'

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

ABOUT THE TEAM

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base. It is a team of a program manager, a content and enablement specialist, a success analytics engineer and a success operations manager, reporting to the Director of Scaled Success. The pooled customer success team is the next team to be added, and this role leads it.

THE ROLE

You build and run the pooled customer success team. Work arrives on a shared queue when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. The signals come from our configuration maturity model, which scores every account on how deeply it has set up the product, and from the automated campaigns that escalate when a customer needs a person.

You design the queue, write the routing rules, set the response standards, build the playbooks, hire the team, and measure whether the motion holds retention in the band it covers. You work directly with the Director, the Scaled Success program manager, the Success Analytics Engineer and the Content and Enablement Specialist.

This team runs on signals, and the help arrives when the customer needs it. The person who builds it will learn how to run customer success this way from the inside, and will have the data to show what works.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Hiring and managing the pooled customer success managers, starting with the first hires in your first quarter

- The playbook library, one per trigger: what a CSM does on a dormant account, a solo user, a stalled onboarding, a cancellation notice, an approaching renewal. Written with the Content and Enablement Specialist and kept current from what the queue teaches you

- The save lane: cancellation and non-renewal signals routed to a person, the reason captured on every one, and the fixable ones fixed

- The expansion hand-off: when the team surfaces seat headroom or a buying signal, the account goes to the account executive working the scaled lanes, with the context they need to close

- The team's readout: queue volume by trigger, time to first response, time to resolution, configuration movement, and retention of covered accounts, built with the Success Analytics Engineer and read monthly

- Capacity: how many accounts one person on the queue can carry, measured from the queue, and the case for extending pooled coverage further down the base as triggers and playbooks mature

- Hire the first pooled customer success managers

title: Revenue Operations Architect — GTM Systems Builder

About Level AI

Level AI is building the LLM-native platform for customer experience. About the Role
This is a builder role and a manager role. You’ll spend your days in Salesforce, in Gong, and in Claude - designing systems and shipping them, not only running a team or maintaining a process someone else defined. Most of the infrastructure doesn’t exist yet. You’ll design it, build it, own it, and prove it works before anyone else has to adopt it.
If you’re energized by a blank canvas and shipping real systems - and you’ve built one, ideally with AI in the loop - we want to talk. If you’ve only maintained a machine someone else built, this isn’t the fit.
What You’ll Build
The forecast and deal engine

• A simplified, high-accuracy forecast off two sources only - Gong + Salesforce - on a MEDDICC-based commit/best-case structure with a +/-5% accuracy target and a weekly CRO cadence.

• The deal desk: pricing guardrails, discount authority, and quote governance - built to move fast without leaking margin.

• Territory and quota models: capacity planning, attainment tracking, and clean routing logic owned in Salesforce.

GTM engineering & signal intelligence

• The signal layer: product usage and intent data routed into a scored queue for BDRs and AEs.

• GTM AI agents you architect and ship - research, sequencing, forecasting, and daily pipeline briefings - productionized, not prototyped.

• An ICP scoring model that sharpens itself as deal data compounds.

The CRO’s operating system

• A live executive dashboard: pipeline coverage, conversion, ramp velocity, NRR, and forecast accuracy - self-serve, not a weekly manual pull.

• The systems and data hygiene that make every number above trustworthy.

GTM execution

• Own cross-functional GTM projects end to end (pricing changes, launches, new-segment entry) with named owners and a clear definition of done on every line.

• Partner with Marketing to keep one pipeline definition and one source of truth - no parallel systems, no competing data.

What You’ll Need

• 6+ years in RevOps, GTM engineering, or sales strategy at high-growth B2B SaaS/AI - ideally through the $20M-$100M ARR scaling phase.

• Hands-on builder. You’ve personally built forecasts, routing logic, deal-desk rules, dashboards, or GTM automations - not just directed a team that did.

• Deep, working fluency in Salesforce and Gong; strong analytical and systems-design instincts.

• A bias toward shipping and finishing: you scope tightly, deliver, and close the loop rather than leaving projects at 80%.

• Comfort building with AI tooling (Claude, agents, LLM-driven workflows) as a core part of the stack, not a novelty.

• Able to influence a tenured, change-resistant seller base by proving value first, then driving adoption.

Nice to Have

• CPQ / Salesforce architecture depth.

• Experience with outbound data infrastructure (enrichment, sequencing, intent).

• Enterprise sales motion and complex-deal support.

This is a zero-to-one, builder-first role. If you want to run a team, this isn’t it. If you want to build the system a great team will run on,

About Stonebranch :
Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration. No matter the degree of automation, the Stonebranch platform is simple, modern, and secure. Using Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC), enterprises can seamlessly orchestrate workloads and data across hybrid IT environments. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with points of contact and support throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Stonebranch serves some of the world’s largest financial, manufacturing, healthcare, travel, transportation, energy, and technology institutions.
Your Part in this Growth Story:
Stonebranch is searching for an ABAP Technical Lead to own the technical direction of BatchMan, our SAP-native workload automation product. We want someone who takes full accountability for a business-critical codebase and moves it forward without waiting to be told what to build next. BatchMan runs inside SAP as an add-on. It extends SAP's native job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation for more than 160 customers, ranging from long-established SAP enterprises to early technology adopters. The architecture decisions you make will shape how the product performs, evolves, and serves those customers for years to come.
This is a role built for where engineering is heading. We are transforming BatchMan development to an AI-first, specification-driven approach, and you'll lead that transformation. Using Claude Code as your primary AI agent, you'll write the technical specifications that drive development, then direct and verify AI-generated code with the senior judgment to catch what the AI gets wrong. That leaves your deepest focus for architecture and the hard technical decisions. On a codebase with more than 15 years of history, that judgment matters most. Knowing where classic ABAP and modern ABAP differ, and where the critical details hide, is what makes AI a force multiplier rather than a risk.
You'll join a small, focused team made up of an experienced fellow developer, AI agents, and the Senior Product Manager who owns the product. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. You will, however, make the high-level architecture decisions for BatchMan and set the engineering standards the codebase is built against. You'll also be the escalation point for our Customer Support team on complex technical issues, and you'll work directly with customers when an escalation calls for it. Because our customer base is largely German-speaking, business-fluent German is required.
Deep, hands-on ABAP expertise is essential. That includes experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on, not only customer-specific extensions. What sets you apart is ownership: the drive to make this product yours and keep it strong over the long term.
This is a remote position open to candidates based anywhere in EMEA, with a preference for candidates located near a Stonebranch office. Quarterly travel to our EMEA headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany or our Honico office in Hamburg, Germany is required. This role reports directly to the Senior Product Manager.
Your Impact on the Organization:
Technical Ownership & Architecture

• Own the technical architecture of BatchMan and make the high-level design decisions that set the product's direction within the SAP landscape

• Establish and maintain the engineering standards, coding conventions, and best practices that the BatchMan codebase is built against

• Maintain and modernize a codebase that spans classic ABAP4, ABAP OO, and Java-based agent components, keeping it stable for existing customers while the product continues to evolve

title: Senior Product Manager, Messaging Platform & AI Services
description:
At ASAPP , our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience-faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1.
We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job-it’s a journey.
You will own the surface where humans and AI work together to serve customers - the messaging platform, the Virtual Agent and the channels it runs on, and the AI Services that make every human agent faster and every automated conversation better. This is one of the largest product surfaces at ASAPP , and it is where the promise of AI-native customer experience is proven or lost.
You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans the Messaging Platform, Virtual Agent, the messaging and voice channels (Web, iOS, Android, Apple Messages for Business, RCS etc), and the AI Services that sit underneath them - AI-assisted human augmentation tools. You will become the go-to expert on this domain, internally and externally, and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders.
The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves - as automation absorbs more of the conversation and the line between human and AI work keeps moving. The strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target, and will bring the technical and customer depth to anticipate what the right target is as AI develops in the space.
What You Will Do

You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely.

• Own the Messaging Platform - the application where live agents handle concurrent conversations, access customer context and knowledge, and collaborate with AI. Own the roadmap for agent productivity and the human side of every AI-assisted interaction.

• Define and execute the Virtual Agent and channels roadmap. Own how customers deploy automated conversations across Web, mobile SDKs, Apple Messages for Business, WhatsApp, RCS and voice, and how those channels stay coherent as the platform grows.

• Lead the AI Services that power the surface - such as automatic conversation summary, voice-to-text transcription and AI-augmented response generation. Own how these services improve agent handle time, quality, and compliance, and decide where to invest as model capabilities change. Reason directly about accuracy, latency, and trust tradeoffs rather than treating them as engineering-only concerns.

• Be the go-to expert on Human + AI collaboration. Represent this surface to customers and account teams, translate their pain into a prioritized roadmap, and be the internal source of truth on how these products work and where they are going.

• Own the external documentation for this surface as part of the product. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them.
Across all of these areas:

• Set strategy and own the roadmap - balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets.

• Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery.

• Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage customer asks with product evolution bets; say no with clarity and evidence.

• Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven

Executing on this responsibility will entail active collaboration with other Anduril teams, including but not limited to Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and Business Operations.

The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.

• Partner with Engineering, Production, and Supply Chain to design packaging that protects high-value and sensitive technology during transport, storage, and deployment

• Lead the design of internal packaging solutions for delivering and presenting parts to the production line and work with the Material Flow Engineering and Industrial Engineering teams on the implementation

• Develop and review prototype requirements, execute against build milestones, and lead sourcing activities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to aid in accurate demand forecasting, procurement planning, and timely delivery of packaging and materials

• Lead risk assessments and investigations for packaging-related issues in transportation and storage

• Utilize ERP & WMS software systems and tools to track packaging inventory, generate reports, and provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and optimization measures

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, safety standards, and quality control protocols in all material management activities

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

• 5+ years of experience in packaging engineering in a high-rate supply chain or manufacturing environment, where complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies are built

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or materials engineering

• Experience with packaging solutions in the automotive, defense, semiconductor, or other relevant industries

• Experience or familiarity with relevant defense packaging and transportation standards

• Strong knowledge of supply chain principles, inventory management techniques, and material planning strategies

• Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency in using software systems and tools, such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, PackAssistant

Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.

Risepoint's Partner Data organization is the operational backbone connecting more than 100 university partners to accurate, timely student and program data. We are seeking a Senior Director, Partner Data Integrations & Operations to lead this organization through its next stage: Reshaping two dedicated teams - Partner Data Operations and Partner Data Enablement, so day-to-day case resolution and forward-looking partner enablement each run to a higher standard.
In this role, you will lead a team who resolve partner data issues, run the recurring processes that keep partner systems in sync, and deliver new partner launches and relaunches. You will transform the team into a Partner Data Integrations & Operations team that runs disciplined, well-governed case management and monitoring, and a Partner Enablement Data team that gets ahead of partner needs - owning onboarding, relaunches, and acting as the systems subject matter expert for partner data integrations. • Drive automation and process redesign to cut repeat, low-judgment case volume and free the team for higher-value work.

title: Offering Tools Finance Lead
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Offering Tools Finance Lead

Purpose

Everpure is looking for a Business Case Finance Lead to build the financial models behind customer business cases. You will build CFO-grade, repeatable and standardised value logic for products across Everpure's portfolio, and own the assumptions, benchmarks and inputs that keep those models accurate. The models feed directly into our wider automated sales operating model, so sellers everywhere present customers with the same credible, defensible numbers.

These models will underpin the proposals used across the entire sales organisation, and form the core of the business cases that go in front of customers. They will cover a wide range of deal sizes, products and industries, so they need to be consistent, robust and adaptable.

The role has three parts:

• Identify the value. Understand how each product creates measurable value for customers, across cost efficiency, growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build the model. Convert that value into a repeatable, standardised financial model, including cash flow, P&L and return metrics, that works across accounts and deal sizes.

• Tell the financial story. Translate the model and its outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that increases the impact of every proposal with customers, including their CFOs and finance teams.

What Success Looks Like

• Credible, robust and accurate financial models underpin the portfolio of Everpure products.

• Models are repeatable and standardised, and can be fed into customer proposals through our wider automated operating model.

• Models and financials are translated into a compelling financial narrative that resonates with customers, including CFOs and finance teams.

• Governance is in place around model inputs, with assumptions validated, updated and maintained.

• Existing models are continually refined as new data is collected and new products are released.

What You'll Be Doing

Value and Financial Models

• Identify how each product creates measurable value for customers across the key value levers: cost efficiency, revenue growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.

• Build CFO-grade financial models, including cash flow and P&L, for each product across the portfolio.

• Standardise models around common inputs and outputs, so they can be repeated efficiently and consistently across accounts and products.

• Apply a consistent methodology and accounting treatment, with ROI, TCO, NPV, IRR and payback calculated the same way every time.

• Continuously improve model accuracy, and develop new, financially robust ways to quantify value.

Financial Narrative

• Translate model outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that shows customers what the investment means for their business.

• Turn complex financial results into tangible measures that customers and sellers can relate to.

• Help sellers position the business case confidently, in executive language.

Assumptions, Inputs and Governance

• Own, govern and maintain the global assumptions, benchmarks and financial inputs feeding the models.

• Identify and add the new pricing, product advances and market trends the models need, within an agreed SLA.

• Define the source, owner and refresh cadence for every input, and maintain a clear version history.

• Reconcile model outputs against real deals to check accuracy over time.

description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Lendable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.

Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, so sharp prioritisation is central to the job. The role also has a real technical edge. Messaging reliability, deliverability and platform integrations are part of what you'll own, so you'll need to be comfortable going deep with engineers. Teams here are small relative to the size of the book we run, so you'll carry more scope and ownership than the same title would at a larger, more layered company.

What you'll be doing

- Owning the roadmap and outcomes for our CRM and lifecycle product: onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation

- Prioritising a pipeline of competing opportunities across CRM, growth, deliverability and platform work, weighing expected impact, effort and risk, and being clear about what we won't do

- Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering

- Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust

- Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact

- Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

- Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

- Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

What we're looking for

ESSENTIAL

title: Product Marketing Manager

What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!

If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb .io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:
Product marketing at Honeycomb is a small team with a wide surface area. We decide how Honeycomb is positioned, what we say at launch, what the sales team brings into a deal, and how an engineer who has never heard of us understands the product in the first two minutes. Because the team is small, the work is broad: in one week you might rewrite a product page, build a competitive one-pager, interview a customer, and run the launch checklist for a new feature.
This role is built for someone early in a product marketing career who wants to systematically improve the customer buying journey. As a product and messaging expert, you will partner with go-to-market teams to drive business impact through sales and marketing campaigns. You will get real ownership of real launches, and you will have senior product marketers, a technical field team, and engineers who like explaining their work close at hand. Our audience is engineers and platform teams, so the bar is accuracy first: we would rather be precise and useful than clever.
What you’ll do in the role:
You will support and execute product marketing across Honeycomb 's core products, with a generalist mix of messaging, launches, content, enablement, and competitive work. Expect to start by contributing to pieces of each and to own more of them over your first year.
Responsibilities

•
Messaging and positioning: Write and maintain messaging for features and product areas, from the one-sentence version an engineer reads on a web page to the slide a sales engineer uses in a technical conversation. Keep it accurate and grounded in what the product actually does.

•
Launches: Run launch execution for small and mid-sized releases and support the larger ones. Build the plan, write the assets, coordinate Product, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and report on how the launch performed.

•
Content: Produce the practical material that helps people evaluate and adopt Honeycomb : blog posts, solution briefs, web copy, demo scripts, FAQs, and customer-facing one-pagers.

•
Sales enablement: Equip the field with what they need to run a good conversation, including pitch narratives, objection handling, battlecards, and release updates. Join customer calls, listen to recorded ones, and fix the material that isn't landing.

•
Competitive and market intelligence: Track the observability market and competitor moves. Maintain competitive assets and keep them current and honest, so the field trusts them.

•
Voice of customer and proof points: Talk to customers and prospects, turn what you hear into case studies, quotes, and proof points, and bring the patterns back to Product and Marketing.

•
Measurement: Help define what success looks like for your work, pull the data, and share

- Produce and automate evidence for technical controls, and keep our cloud environments connected to our compliance platform (Drata).

- Serve as technical expert for audits, customer security reviews, and vendor assessments involving sensitive data.

- 3+ years in DevSecOps, security engineering, cloud security, or a closely related role

- Hands-on experience securing GCP and/or AWS, including managed Kubernetes (GKE, EKS)

title: Account Director
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together - powerfully and intentionally - to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups - Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. 

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.  

We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Construction Superintendent, Fluid/Mechanical - Memphis
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

CONSTRUCTION SUPERINTENDENT, FLUID/MECHANICAL

Most construction jobs manage someone else’s crew on someone else’s schedule, then end when the project does. This one does not.

SpaceX builds its own launch sites, factories, test stands, and AI superclusters - and it plans to keep building. The rockets, the chips, and the missions only matter if the ground under them is real. Construction is how that ground gets built, in-house and to a standard the company can actually use. The work does not dry up between jobs. There is a next site, and one after that. You lead the crew that builds them.

You own a self-performing team. Foremen run their people day to day. You run the foremen. You are in the dirt, walking the work, setting the bar, and clearing whatever is in the way. When someone is ready for more, you say so. When the standard slips, you deal with it.

Scope includes, but not limited to industrial HVAC, pipefitting, pipe welding, chilled water, cooling towers, chillers, condensers, CRAC and CRAH units, and setting that heavy mechanical equipment. It also includes all plumbing: domestic water, sanitary, drain-waste-vent, and floor drains. It includes all fire protection: sprinkler fitting, suppression, and pre-action. This is the work that moves heat, water, and fire protection through the building.

The team goes where the next site is - a pad, a factory, a supercluster, whatever has to exist before the rest of the company can move. Right now that is Memphis, TN / Southaven, MS. Then it is the next one. Per diem comes with the assignment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Directly oversee foremen and, through them, a large self-perform fluid/mechanical crew installing industrial HVAC, pipe, chilled water, cooling towers, chillers, condensers, CRAC and CRAH units, plumbing, and fire protection, including pipe welding and setting heavy mechanical equipment

• Set clear expectations for safety, quality, schedule, and conduct, and hold foremen and crews accountable when those expectations are missed

• Remove roadblocks so crews can keep working: materials, access, sequencing, coordination with other trades, and decisions

• Recommend promotions, role changes, and corrective action based on performance

• Plan and run the night-shift assignment, including extended hours, as part of a 24/7 operation

• Keep fluid and mechanical installations on SpaceXSI’s quality and reliability standards, including code compliance and system integrity required for data center cooling and fire protection

• Track daily progress and maintain logs, red-line drawings, and as-built documentation for mechanical, plumbing, and fire-protection systems

• Build and hold an aggressive construction schedule, on time and within budget

• Champion SpaceXSI’s safety program and a zero-incident culture around pressure piping, hot work, rigging and setting heavy mechanical equipment, and work at heights

• Resolve on-site issues - material delays, technical conflicts, sequencing, and trade coordination - with attention to system integrity and code compliance

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're VOID Interactive , the kickass team behind the best-selling FPS game, Ready or Not. We're made up of some seriously talented individuals who love games and creating awesome content together. We're currently looking for a dedicated and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join us remotely and help take us to the next level. Our goal is strong: to establish Ready or Not as the quintessential FPS of our time.
Role Overview
As a DevOps Engineer at VOID Interactive , you will play a critical role in standardizing and automating our development and release workflows across multiple platforms. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, technical designers, QA, and production to ensure our CI/CD systems, source control, development and production environments, and deployment pipelines are robust, scalable, and efficient.
This role requires a proactive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced game development environments and is passionate about automation, optimisation, and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities

• Standardise and automate artefact generation across multiple platforms

• Develop, manage, and continuously improve end-to-end release processes

• Optimise source control workflows and CI/CD pipelines

• Manage and assist in microservice development and deployment life cycles

• Maintain and improve build systems and infrastructure reliability

• Implement and manage configuration management solutions

• Apply and enforce basic security best practices across pipelines and infrastructure

• Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline and infrastructure issues efficiently

• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, QA, and production teams

• Document processes and contribute to operational best practices
Essential Requirements

• Minimum 3+ years experience in a DevOps, Build Engineer, or similar role

• Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

• Strong understanding of source control systems and workflow optimisation

• Experience administering Perforce

• Experience with configuration management solutions

• Experience managing microservices and deployment pipelines

• Knowledge of basic security principles (access control, secrets management, pipeline security)

• Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills

• Clear and effective communication skills

• Ability to work autonomously in a remote-first environment
Nice to Have (Bonus Skills)

• Experience optimising Unreal Engine build times

• Knowledge of multiple programming languages such as C++ and Python

• Experience working in a game development environment

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)

• Experience supporting multi-platform releases (PC, console)
Please Note:
For Irish residents, this role is offered as a full-time employee position. For applicants based outside of Ireland, the role will be offered on a contractor basis. We are a remote-first company and are committed to hiring the best candidate for the role, regardless of where you are located. If you are outside our company’s home base, that’s okay with us.
